title: spells
summary: Benilla's cast pipeline: the four CMSG_CAST_SPELL target shapes, CMSG_CANCEL_CAST/CHANNELLING/AURA, SMSG_CAST_RESULT, SPELL_START/GO (write-side-order SpellCastTargets, ammo block, miss list with reflect byte), SPELL_FAILED_OTHER, SPELL_DELAYED, MSG_CHANNEL_START/UPDATE, SMSG_UPDATE_AURA_DURATION, SMSG_PLAY_SPELL_VISUAL, SMSG_SPELL_UPDATE_CHAIN_TARGETS. MSUI implements nearly all of it (SpellPackets.cs parses match Benilla bit for bit, incl. the reflect tail and the no-transport-guid source location), with two concrete divergences.

openItems.text: SMSG_SPELL_UPDATE_CHAIN_TARGETS has no handler - the channeled-beam hop list (Drain Life / Mind Flay style, vmangos sends it from SendChannelStart) is dropped, so packet-delivered chain visuals have no data source

GameObject cast mask divergence: WorldSession.BuildCastSpellOnGameObjectBody writes target mask 0x4800 (GAMEOBJECT|0x4000 LOCKED) where Benilla decision 0939 byte-verified the real client sends 0x0800 alone - the LOCKED bit is a client-internal targeting-word bit that never rides the wire
